changelog:
keyapi-amazon-ecommerce v1.0.0

- Initial release providing unified access to Amazon e-commerce intelligence via KeyAPI MCP.
- Enables comprehensive product search, category browsing, best seller/deal monitoring, and product detail retrieval across 24 Amazon marketplaces.
- Supports seller intelligence (profiles, catalogs, reviews) and influencer storefront research.
- Includes ASIN/GTIN conversion, review analysis, and offer comparison.
- Features multi-ASIN batch queries, advanced filtering, and full multi-marketplace support.
- Plain-text workflow, clear node mapping, and setup instructions provided in documentation.
summary: Explore and analyze Amazon e-commerce data at scale — product search, category browsing, product details, best sellers, deals, seller intelligence, influence...
